chunks: They will say: 'No, you were the ones who would not believe.'
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers say when asked to bring their leaders to judgment on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah As-Saffat, the disbelievers, when commanded to summon their chiefs for accountability, retort that they themselves were never truly believers, thereby shifting the blame for their misguidance onto their leaders. This highlights the psychological mechanism of denial and the fragmentation of unity among the polytheists, a theme frequently discussed by Shia exegetes like Al-Tabarsi to illustrate how false leadership leads to collective spiritual ruin.
